results.title: RBI rejects Tata Sons’ bid to surrender NBFC licence, setting stage for mandatory listing
results.description: Mumbai: The Reserve Bank has rejected Tata Sons’ application to surrender its core investment company registration, killing the Tata Group holding company’s attempt to avoid a mandatory stock-market listing and setting the stage for it to become publicly traded, sources said Saturday. The rejection was conveyed in a letter received by Tata Sons’ company secretary [...]
